{"id":1849568667,"question_id":4119,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"7 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1765135273,"status":14,"status_display":"Time Limit Exceeded","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1849568667/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Distance Between Three Equal Elements II","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int minimumDistance(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int ans = -1;\n        int mini = INT_MAX;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<nums.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            for(int j = i+1 ; j<nums.size() ; j++)\n            {\n                for(int k = j+1 ; k < nums.size() ; k++)\n                {\n                    if(nums[i] == nums[j] and nums[j] == nums[k])\n                    {\n                        ans = 2 * (k - i);\n                        mini = min(mini , ans);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        return mini == INT_MAX ? -1 : mini;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-distance-between-three-equal-elements-ii","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1270}
